# Cairo — agent-first event tracking

Cairo ingests events from products and agents, then hands notifications to agents.
Agents relay to end users via their own gateways (Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp…).
Cairo does NOT talk to messaging gateways itself.

Base URL: your Cairo host
Auth: X-Write-Key header (or Authorization: Bearer <key>)

## Turnkey agent path
1. Human runs: `cairo agent-config --host <url> --agent-id <id>` → paste MCP JSON into the agent
2. Agent MCP package: `npx -y @ani-hq/cairo-mcp` (full surface). Not `@ani-hq/agent-mcp` (telemetry only).
3. User says: set up Product X; notify on signup / checkout / errors
4. Agent calls `setup_product` → returns product write_key + install snippets
5. Product posts to `/v2/track` with that key
6. Agent calls `drain_notifications` → relays via its gateway → `ack_notification`

Docs: GET /docs · GET /llms.txt · docs/AGENT_ONBOARDING.md

## Discovery
- GET /mcp — MCP tool discovery
- GET /docs — HTML docs
- GET /llms.txt — this file
- GET /health — health check
- GET /.well-known/mcp.json — MCP well-known

## MCP (POST /mcp)

JSON-RPC 2.0. Methods: initialize, tools/list, tools/call, ping.

### Onboarding
- setup_product { product_name, agent_id, events[], namespace?, message_template? }
  Creates a product write key + one rule per event. Returns write_key (once) and install snippets.
- drain_notifications { agent_id?, namespace?, limit? }
  Pending notifications in relay-ready shape: id, message, event, user, properties, channels.

### Events
- track_event { event, user_id?, user_email?, anonymous_id?, properties?, namespace? }
- batch_track { events: [...], namespace? }
- query_events { user_id?, event?, since?, until?, limit? }

### Users
- identify_user { user_id, traits?, anonymous_id?, namespace? }
  traits may include telegram_chat_id / discord_user_id / whatsapp_number / slack_user_id
  (stored in user_channels for agents to look up when relaying)
- lookup_user { user_id? | email? } — returns user + channels

### Identity
- resolve_identity { user_id?, anonymous_id?, email?, namespace? }
- alias_identity { previous_id, user_id, namespace? }

### Errors
- capture_error { message, stack?, level?, user_id?, tags?, extra?, namespace? }
- list_error_groups { status?, limit?, namespace? }
- get_error_group { fingerprint }
- resolve_error { fingerprint }
- error_trends { timeRange?, namespace? }

### Notifications (agent handoff)
- set_user_channel { user_id, channel: telegram|discord|whatsapp|slack|other, address, namespace? }
- create_notification_rule { name, event_name, agent_id, message_template, property_match?, namespace? }
  template vars: {{event}}, {{userId}}, {{properties.x}}, {{channels.telegram}}
- list_notification_rules { namespace? }
- delete_notification_rule { id }
- enqueue_notification { agent_id, text, user_id?, event_name?, properties?, namespace? }
- get_pending_notifications { agent_id?, limit?, namespace? }
  each row payload includes channels{} for gateway addresses
- ack_notification { id, status?: sent|failed|acked }
- register_agent_webhook { agent_id, url, namespace? }

### GDPR
- gdpr_delete_user { user_id, namespace? }
- gdpr_suppress_user { user_id, reason?, namespace? }
- gdpr_unsuppress_user { user_id, namespace? }
- gdpr_check_suppression { user_id, namespace? }

### Auth
- create_write_key { name?, key? }
- list_write_keys {}
- revoke_write_key { id }

### Agents / System
- query_agent_sessions { agent_id?, limit?, namespace? }
- system_health {}
- describe_tool { name }

## REST (also under /api/v2)
- POST /v2/track | /v2/batch | /v2/identify | /v2/page | /v2/screen | /v2/group | /v2/alias
- /v2/identities/* — identity
- /v2/users/:id — GDPR
- /v2/errors/* — error tracking
- /v2/agent/* — agent sessions

## Auth notes
- Pass X-Write-Key or Authorization: Bearer on every /mcp and /v2 request
- NODE_ENV=production or CAIRO_REQUIRE_WRITE_KEYS=true disables bootstrap
- Create keys: CLI `cairo create-write-key --name prod` or MCP create_write_key
- Agent install: `cairo agent-config --host <url> --agent-id <id>`

## Typical agent relay loop
1. setup_product (or create_notification_rule) targeting your agent_id
2. Events arrive → Cairo enqueues pending notifications
3. drain_notifications → relay via your gateway using channels{}
4. ack_notification
